units.source_text: 古歌：“青松千岁寿，谁是此君俦？

en.t: An old poem says: “The green pine lives for a thousand years; who can be a companion to this noble one?

units.source_text: 可叹浮生短，情场不自由。”

en.t: How sad that fleeting life is short, and in the realm of love one is not free.”
This is found in Kokin Wakashu Rokujō.
